description: Output of the review role: an update for every open finding in the ledger, plus any new findings supported by evidence from the diff.

summary.description: Two to five sentences: what the diff does, what each pass (bugs, security, compliance) found, and whether the change is fit to merge. When `complete` is false, this is where you say what stopped you.

complete.description: true only when you read the entire diff and ran all three passes (bugs, security, compliance). false when anything prevented that — the diff file could not be read, a tool you needed was unavailable, you never reached the end of the file — with the reason in `summary`. false rejects the round: the factory records nothing, because empty findings are not approval.

updates.description: One entry for every finding marked NEEDS UPDATE in the ledger. No entries for findings that are already resolved or dismissed.

id.description: The finding id from the ledger, e.g. 'F3'.

status.description: 'resolved' only when the diff demonstrably fixes it; otherwise 'unresolved'.

evidence.description: Why, citing the diff: file path, line, and a quoted snippet. For 'unresolved', say what is still wrong.

new.description: Findings raised this round. Only defects you can point at in the diff. Never re-raise a resolved or dismissed finding. Respect the nit cap in the review policy.

severity.description: 'important' blocks the PR and must be fixed; 'nit' never blocks and is never auto-fixed.

pass.description: Which review pass raised it: 'bugs' (correctness), 'security', or 'compliance' (against spec.md and plan.md).

file.description: Repository-relative path of the offending file, exactly as it appears in the diff.

line.description: Line number in the new version of the file, or null when the finding is not tied to one line.

title.description: One short imperative line naming the defect. Stable wording: it is hashed to detect duplicates across rounds.

detail.description: What goes wrong, under which inputs or conditions, and what the consequence is.

evidence.description: A quoted snippet from the diff at file:line that shows the defect, plus the reasoning that connects it to the claim.
